params.feed: 0..1 the code block leaves the press and rides the belt to the gate
params.check: 0..1 the feeler drops onto the part and lifts again (lit while down)
params.ok: 0..1 green lamp, the part turns green and rides on into the tray (lands on top of `count` parts)
params.bad: 0..1 red lamp, the part turns red; the kicker pushes it onto the return chute (to 0.35) and the chute carries it back to the press
params.count: 0..3 green parts already in the done tray
params.part: 0..1 the moving part shows (0 hides it: an empty line)
